paragraphs: Avanish Singh Visen is the Director and CEO of DCJ Group, which spans APPL, Encraft and Enzocraft. He has spent over two decades across automotive, IT, home appliances, polymer and fenestration, with roles at Lenovo, Videocon and Mahindra before joining the group.

He built his career in supply chain and sourcing, and rose from SCM Head to CEO. Under him, Encraft became one of India's most awarded uPVC door and window brands, and the group grew on one rule: move fast, and never compromise on quality.
